mysql_basedir.description: Base directory where MySQL binaries and support files are installed.

mysql_dataadir.description: Directory where MySQL stores its data files (databases, logs, etc.).

mysql_socket.description: Unix socket file used for local client connections.

mysql_port.description: TCP port on which MySQL listens for incoming client connections.

mysql_max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

mysql_max_allowed_packet.description: Maximum size of a single packet or intermediate string (e.g., '64M', '256M').

mysql_character_set_server.description: Default character set for new databases and tables.

mysql_collation_server.description: Default collation (sorting rules) for new databases.

mysql_skip_name_resolve.description: Skip reverse DNS lookups for client hostnames (recommended for security).

mysql_bind_address.description: IP address to bind to; set to '' to listen on all interfaces, or '127.0.0.1' for localhost-only.

mysql_sql_mode.description: List of SQL mode flags to enforce strict behavior and safety.

items.description: A single SQL mode flag (e.g., STRICT_TRANS_TABLES).

mysql_timeout_connect.description: Seconds to wait before aborting connection handshake.

mysql_timeout_wait.description: Seconds to wait for a read or write operation on an active connection.

mysql_timeout_read.description: Seconds to wait for more data from client before aborting read.

mysql_timeout_write.description: Seconds to wait for more data to client before aborting write.

mysql_lock_wait_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a table lock before timing out.

mysql_innodb_lock_wait_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for an InnoDB row lock before timing out.

mysql_interactive_timeout.description: Seconds before closing interactive connections (e.g., mysql CLI).

mysql_net_read_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a read from a client before aborting.

mysql_net_write_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a write to a client before aborting.

mysql_innodb_buffer_pool_size.description: Size of InnoDB’s main cache (e.g., '256M', '1G') — typically 50-80% of system RAM on DB-only servers.

mysql_innodb_log_file_size.description: Size of each InnoDB redo log file (affects crash recovery and write throughput).

mysql_innodb_log_buffer_size.description: Size of buffer for InnoDB log writes before flushing to disk.

mysql_log_bin.description: Enable binary logging for replication, point-in-time recovery, and audit.

mysql_server_id.description: Unique server identifier for replication topologies.

mysql_binlog_format.description: Binary log format: 'STATEMENT' (legacy), 'ROW' (safe and recommended), or 'MIXED'.

mysql_expire_logs_days.description: Number of days to retain binary logs before automatic cleanup.

mysql_max_binlog_size.description: Maximum size per binary log file before rotation.

mysql_log_error.description: Path to the error log file.

mysql_slow_query_log.description: Enable logging of slow queries for performance tuning.

mysql_long_query_time.description: Threshold (seconds) above which queries are logged as slow.

mysql_slow_query_log_file.description: Path to the slow query log file.

mysql_custom_ini.description: Free-form key-value pairs for advanced or vendor-specific settings (not validated by schema).

items.description: INI config option value (must be valid for MySQL/InnoDB).
